citeAs: Muennighoff, N., Tazi, N., Magne, L., Reimers, N. (2023). MTEB: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark. EACL 2023.
creator: Niklas Muennighoff, Nouamane Tazi, Loïc Magne, Nils Reimers (Hugging Face, cohere.ai)
description: STS22 is a crosslingual semantic textual similarity dataset included in MTEB. It contains sentence pairs across 18 language pairs (including Arabic, English, French, German, Turkish, Spanish, Polish, Italian, Russian, and Chinese), where the goal is to assess the similarity of two sentences in different languages. Labels are continuous scores between 0 and 5, and the main metric is Spearman correlation based on cosine similarity.
inLanguage: ar, en, fr, de, tr, es, pl, it, ru, zh
name: STS22 (Crosslingual STS)
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Sentence pairs are annotated with continuous similarity scores from 0 to 5, where higher scores indicate more similar sentences. This follows the standard SemEval STS annotation protocol.
rai:dataCollection: STS22 is part of the SemEval STS benchmark series. It contains crosslingual sentence pairs with similarity scores from 0 to 5. The dataset covers 18 language pairs among Arabic, English, French, German, Turkish, Spanish, Polish, Italian, Russian, and Chinese. It is incorporated into MTEB as a semantic textual similarity task.
rai:dataLimitations: MTEB notes that STS is known to poorly correlate with other real-world use cases. The benchmark also notes that retrieval and clustering tasks in MTEB are English-only, while STS22 covers crosslingual pairs. Additionally, MTEB's average scores are biased towards tasks with many datasets (retrieval, classification, clustering), and summarization and pair classification are underrepresented.
rai:dataSocialImpact: STS22 as part of MTEB enables more comprehensive evaluation of multilingual text embedding models, which can improve NLP applications across many languages. The benchmark aims to make selecting the right embedding model easier and simplify future embedding research, potentially benefiting multilingual NLP applications.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating text embedding models on crosslingual semantic textual similarity tasks; benchmarking multilingual embedding models; assessing the ability of models to measure sentence similarity across different languages.
